newsitem.title: USA: Medusa says to take Q4 charge of $1.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Medusa says to take Q4 charge of $1.8 mln.

text.p: Medusa Corp said it will post a pretax extraordinary charge of about $1.8 million after tax, or about $.10 per fully diluted share, in the fourth quarter.
The charge is related to the results of the October 31 call for redemption of the entire $57.5 million of six percent convertible subordinated notes due 2003.
The noteholders representing $26.7 million of the notes have converted their holdings into approximately 805,000 Medusa Common Shares.
The noteholders had until November 27, to convert their notes into Medusa Corporation Common shares at a conversion price of $33,125 per share.
The balance of the Notes of $30.9 million have been redeemed for cash of $32.1 million.
Medusa produces and sells portland and masonry cements, mines, processes, and sells aggregates and industrial limestone products; and provides construction services for highway safety.
